title: Cultivate Silence
coreMove: Silence is not blank space; it is chosen quiet that lets you hear the cough, the conscience, and the better sentence before noise grabs the room again.

exampleSpecs.domain: a pianist rehearsing how to introduce silence without rescuing the room
exampleSpecs.audience: people who fill quiet because they fear being judged
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the room hears what the expected performance usually covers
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Manon works through her wrong turns while holding John Cage's 4′33″ in mind.

exampleSpecs.domain: a community facilitator planning an agenda before anyone arrives
exampleSpecs.audience: leaders who treat pauses as wasted time
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether scarce meeting attention goes to reflexive talk or necessary speech
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hannah allocates meeting attention before any action happens, drawing from Quaker silent worship.

exampleSpecs.domain: a curator introducing a difficult performance
exampleSpecs.audience: communicators tempted to explain away every discomfort
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether explanation protects attention or smothers it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Edouard faces two bad options before presenting John Cage's 4′33″.

exampleSpecs.domain: two committee members before a tense vote
exampleSpecs.audience: teams that use talk to avoid listening
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether speech becomes more responsible before a decision
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Audrey and Ryan let the lesson emerge through talk about Quaker silent worship.

exampleSpecs.domain: a product review borrowing a timed silence from a music case
exampleSpecs.audience: teams that expect silence to kill energy
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether quiet exposes a missed signal in the work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The expected awkward pause reveals useful attention instead.

exampleSpecs.domain: a short message thread about adding silence to a tense agenda
exampleSpecs.audience: organizers who fear quiet will look unprepared
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a planned pause becomes visible enough to protect
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A compressed exchange carries the Quaker lesson between the lines.
